query:
-- Encontrar cobranças do Stenio com payment_links preenchido (split já aplicado)
SELECT id, client_id, type, value, amount_paid, status, due_date, asaas_payment_id, payment_links
FROM subscription_charges
WHERE client_id IN (
  SELECT id FROM allowed_clients WHERE LOWER(name) LIKE '%stenio%' OR LOWER(email) LIKE '%stenio%'
)
ORDER BY due_date DESC
LIMIT 20;
